name: Chrysaora hysoscella
changes: Four curved closed V-section oral-arm exteriors with finer irregular frilled edges, broader proximal regions and selected curled ends replace stiff narrow plates
Selected smooth saucer-like closed bell with 32 rounded lappets and original attached branching cream/brown pigment
Twenty-four tapered curved adult marginal tentacles grouped three per octant, with selected equal longitudinal extent and different apparent extension
Finite eight-second regional contraction/recovery and delayed appendage flexion on retained geometry/material/colour, neutral start/end and held completion without root travel

originalProfilePhotograph.changes: Technical resizing, flattening and JPEG delivery; no generative alteration.
originalProfilePhotograph.identityScope: Source-identified photographed individual; illumination, stage and variation require specialist verification. Original authored geometry is not a scan of this specimen.

sources.title: Naturalis · North Sea compass-jelly adult exterior account
sources.scope: Actual description read: smooth saucer-like bell, variable lappet counts and colour, 24 adult marginal tentacles in eight groups of three, four narrow V-section frilled oral arms and possibly coiled terminal regions. Selected model counts/proportions are unmeasured. Historical worldwide range and internal stomach-pouch statements are not imported as modern concept validation or resolved anatomy.

sources.title: DORIS · Chrysaora hysoscella, Mediterranean exterior observations
sources.scope: Actual selected description/captions and complete Martin Vranken 26 May 2016 Calanques profile photograph inspected. Four strongly frilled proximal oral arms, transparent marginal tentacles and branched brown bell bands inform the selected exterior. Vranken photograph is a private comparison with separate copyright, not redistributed or claimed openly licensed. Water/camera colour and posture do not establish intrinsic pigment, dimensions or kinematics. Juveniles differ; model is an adult selection.

sources.title: Martellos, Ukosich & Avian 2016 · JellyWeb, comparative identification key
sources.scope: Actual official Europe PMC full-text XML, PMCID PMC4740827, selected comparative key couplets 126–134 read. Key separates 24-tentacle forms and linear frilled oral arms, with internal pouch distinctions that are not resolved by this exterior. Its pouch wording differs from the historical Naturalis account; neither is presented as a fitted internal reconstruction. Figures are information-system interfaces, not viewed organism motion. Author-hosted PDF returned 403; no PDF/figure retrieval is claimed.

sources.title: Hays et al.2008 · individual compass-jelly vertical movements
sources.scope: Previously accessible abstract concerns 15 tagged compass jellyfish off Dingle, Ireland, and whole-animal depth changes. New full opening failed; no new full paper or figure inspection. It does not provide the local arm trajectories, measured pulse period, forces or hydrodynamic controller used here. The eight-second study is independently authored and illustrative.

sourceReview.actuallyInspected: Whole retained Luc Viatour aquarium photograph and complete privately retrieved Martin Vranken2016 DORIS Mediterranean profile photograph. Actual Naturalis/DORIS adult descriptions and captions plus selected JellyWeb2016 comparative key couplets126–134 in official Europe PMC XML. No new primary organism-motion figure or video was inspected.
sourceReview.scope: Viatour whole frame remains public under CC BY-SA3.0. Vranken photograph has separate copyright and is not redistributed. Aquarium blue lighting and underwater colour are not intrinsic tissue-colour measurements. Identification is source-associated, not independent specimen redetermination. Historical southern-African hysoscella research may concern C.fulgida; it is not used as exact-species motion data.
sourceReview.primaryAccess: JellyWeb full XML was actually retrieved through official Europe PMC; author-hosted PDF403 and publisher403 were not bypassed. Its figures are information-system interfaces, not local kinematics. Internal pouch descriptions differ from the older Naturalis account and remain unresolved; no internal pouch reconstruction is claimed. Morandini/Marques2010 abstract only, subscription full PDF not acquired. Hays2008 prior abstract only,15tagged animals and whole-animal depths, not fitted local arm/bell motion.

softwareChecks.scope: Full317pass precedes the final marginal-root attachment adjustment; all23affected checks pass afterward, including a new actual bell-triangle contact check. Frozen published CI is a separate gate. Initial316/317historical-hash failure and exact ledger replay repair retained. Software consistency only, not biological validation.

limitations: Oral-arm folds, V-section thickness, proximal tissue union, terminal curls, lappet profile and numerical pigment remain selected and partly stylized. Closed pieces overlap, without fused histology, open food grooves or resolved canals/gonads/rhopalia. No measured optical constants, pressure, flow, contact, nematocyst discharge, feeding, complete swimming or physiological simulation. Fine folds still form numerical rhythms; the central manubrial union and selected curling profiles remain simplified. Marginal threads can look dotted at this display scale in software rendering although the checked meshes are connected. This release has software compatibility visual review only; final WebGL optical appearance is not established. No photorealism, independent specialist certification or accuracy percentage is claimed.
